steps.label: num_leaves
steps.sub: The key complexity knob -- keep it small

code:
lg = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500, learning_rate=0.05, num_leaves=8,
    subsample=0.8, subsample_freq=1, colsample_bytree=0.8)
lg.fit(X_fit, y_fit, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
       eval_metric="auc",
       callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(30, verbose=False)])

# stopped at round 115, test AUC 0.830
caption: category dtype used natively -- no encoding step needed

code:
cb = CatBoostClassifier(
    iterations=500, learning_rate=0.05, depth=4,
    eval_metric="AUC", early_stopping_rounds=30)
cb.fit(X_fit_cb, y_fit, cat_features=["plan"],
       eval_set=(X_val_cb, y_val))

# stopped at round 123, test AUC 0.831
caption: cat_features tells CatBoost which columns are categorical -- no manual encoding
